| `update_environment` | write | PUT | `/api/environments/{id}` | Update an environment; renaming also renames its on-disk stacks/git-repos directories |
| `update_environment_notification` | write | PUT | `/api/environments/{id}/notifications/{notificationId}` | Update a notification-channel link (enabled state and/or event type filter) |
| `update_general_settings` | write | POST | `/api/settings/general` | Update global general settings (all fields optional; only supplied keys are written) |
| `update_git_credential` | write | PUT | `/api/git/credentials/{id}` | Update a git credential and return it with secrets stripped |
| `update_git_repository` | write | PUT | `/api/git/repositories/{id}` | Update a git repository's basic fields (name/url/branch/credential) |
| `update_git_stack` | write | PUT | `/api/git/stacks/{id}` | Update a git stack (rename, schedule, webhook, secret-provider binding) |
| `update_ldap_provider` | write | PUT | `/api/auth/ldap/{id}` | Update an existing LDAP provider configuration (only supplied fields change; a masked bindPassword is ignored) |
| `update_navigation_settings` | write | PUT | `/api/settings/navigation` | Update navigation preferences (landing page, env-click target) at global or per-user scope |
| `update_notification` | write | PUT | `/api/notifications/{id}` | Update a notification setting; a masked SMTP password ("********") keeps the stored value |
| `update_oidc_provider` | write | PUT | `/api/auth/oidc/{id}` | Update an existing OIDC provider configuration (only supplied fields change; a masked clientSecret is ignored) |
| `update_profile` | write | PUT | `/api/profile` | Update the authenticated user's own profile (email/display name, and optionally the password with current-password confirmation) |
| `update_profile_preferences` | write | PUT | `/api/profile/preferences` | Update the current user's UI preferences (each field is optional) |
| `update_registry` | write | PUT | `/api/registries/{id}` | Update a registry (optionally set as default); credentials are trimmed and the response strips the password |
| `update_role` | write | PUT | `/api/roles/{id}` | Update a custom role (system roles cannot be modified; enterprise, admin required when auth is enabled) |
| `update_scanner_settings` | write | POST | `/api/settings/scanner` | Save the vulnerability-scanner settings for an environment |
| `update_schedule_settings` | write | PUT | `/api/schedules/settings` | Update the schedules-page display preference (hide system jobs) for the current user |
| `update_secret_provider` | write | PUT | `/api/secret-providers/{id}` | Update a secret provider (name, type, and/or rotate its config); omitted fields are left unchanged |
| `update_semver_settings` | write | POST | `/api/settings/semver` | Set the global newer-version-tag (semver) detection config |
| `update_stack_compose` | write | PUT | `/api/stacks/{name}/compose` | Save a stack's compose file (and optionally relocate it, bind a secret provider, and redeploy) |
| `update_stack_env` | write | PUT | `/api/stacks/{name}/env` | Save a stack's env vars to the DB |
| `update_stack_env_raw` | write | PUT | `/api/stacks/{name}/env/raw` | Write raw .env file content to disk for a stack; empty content deletes the .env file, and masked "***" placeholders are rejected to avoid corrupting secrets |
| `update_tag` | write | PUT | `/api/tags/{id}` | Update a global catalog tag's name and/or colour |
| `update_template_source` | write | PUT | `/api/templates/sources` | Update a template source — toggle enabled, or change its name/URL (only provided fields are changed) |
| `update_user` | write | PUT | `/api/users/{id}` | Update a user (self-edit is always allowed; admin/active changes require admin; demoting or deactivating the last admin needs confirmDisableAuth) |
| `upload_container_file` | write | POST | `/api/containers/{id}/files/upload` | Upload one or more files into a container directory (requires the 'exec' permission) |
| `validate_config` | read | — | — | — |
| `validate_stack_compose` | read | POST | `/api/stacks/{name}/validate` | Run the Compose Validate preflight linter on a compose file and return findings with severities and line numbers (requires the 'view' permission) |
| `validate_stack_env` | read | POST | `/api/stacks/{name}/env/validate` | Validate a stack's defined environment variables against the variables required/optional by its compose file (compose content and the defined variable list may be supplied in the body, otherwise loaded from the saved file/DB) |
| `validate_stack_path` | read | POST | `/api/stacks/validate-path` | Validate a candidate external stack path (exists, is a directory, no overlap with already-configured paths); validation failures are returned as 200 with valid=false |
| `verify_backup_destination` | write | POST | `/api/backup/destinations/{id}/verify` | Verify the integrity of a destination's backups by reading a data subset, streaming progress as a Server-Sent Events job |
| `write_container_file_content` | write | PUT | `/api/containers/{id}/files/content` | Overwrite the content of a file inside a container (max 1 MB, requires the 'exec' permission) |
| `write_system_file` | write | POST | `/api/system/files` | Create a directory on Dockhand's local filesystem (absolute path, no traversal, non-protected) |
